public_declarations.name: chenY1011JointPrimeSelector
public_declarations.header:
def chenY1011JointPrimeSelector (N : ℕ) (A H D : ℝ)
    (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) : Finset ((ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ))

public_declarations.name: chenY10PrimeSelector_disjoint_chenY11FullPrimeSelector
public_declarations.header:
theorem chenY10PrimeSelector_disjoint_chenY11FullPrimeSelector
    (N : ℕ) (A H D : ℝ) :
    Disjoint (chenY10PrimeSelector N A H) (chenY11FullPrimeSelector N A H D)

public_declarations.name: chenY1011JointPrimeSelector_eq_union
public_declarations.header:
theorem chenY1011JointPrimeSelector_eq_union (N : ℕ) (A H D : ℝ)
    (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) (hHD : H ≤ D) :
    chenY1011JointPrimeSelector N A H D E =
      chenY10PrimeSelector N A H ∪
        (chenY11FullPrimeSelector N A H D).filter (fun t => ¬ E t.2)

public_declarations.name: sum_chenY1011JointPrimeSelector
public_declarations.header:
theorem sum_chenY1011JointPrimeSelector (N : ℕ) (A H D : ℝ)
    (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) (hHD : H ≤ D)
    (f : ((ℕ × ℕ) × (ℕ × ℕ)) → ℝ) :
    (∑ t ∈ chenY1011JointPrimeSelector N A H D E, f t) =
      (∑ t ∈ chenY10PrimeSelector N A H, f t) +
        ∑ t ∈ (chenY11FullPrimeSelector N A H D).filter (fun t => ¬ E t.2),
          f t

public_declarations.name: sum_chenY10_add_chenY11_compl_eq_joint_source
public_declarations.header:
theorem sum_chenY10_add_chenY11_compl_eq_joint_source
    (N : ℕ) (A H D : ℝ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) (hHD : H ≤ D) :
    (∑ P ∈ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N, (chenY10 (N - P) A H : ℝ)) +
      (∑ P ∈ chenAdditivePrimeCarrier N,
        (chenY11Selected (N - P) A H D (fun t => ¬ E t) : ℝ)) =
      ∑ t ∈ chenY1011JointPrimeSelector N A H D E,
        ((chenSiftedQuotientPrimeSource N (t.1.1 * t.1.2 * t.2.1 * t.2.2)
          (t.1.2 : ℝ)).card : ℝ)

public_declarations.name: currentChenUpsilon10_add_11_eq_joint_source
public_declarations.header:
theorem currentChenUpsilon10_add_11_eq_joint_source (N : ℕ)
    (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) (hN : 1 ≤ (N : ℝ)) :
    currentChenUpsilon10 N + currentChenUpsilon11 N E =
      ∑ t ∈ chenY1011JointPrimeSelector N
          ((N : ℝ) ^ (417 / 5000 : ℝ)) ((N : ℝ) ^ (19 / 125 : ℝ))
          ((N : ℝ) ^ (59 / 250 : ℝ)) E,
        ((chenSiftedQuotientPrimeSource N (t.1.1 * t.1.2 * t.2.1 * t.2.2)
          (t.1.2 : ℝ)).card : ℝ)

    (i : Fin 11) (P : ℕ) (q : P5WitnessFour) :
    (P, q) ∈ p5MarkedRowSource N E i ↔

public_declarations.name: p5MarkedRowSource_card
public_declarations.header:
theorem p5MarkedRowSource_card (N : ℕ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) (i : Fin 11) :
    ((p5MarkedRowSource N E i).card : ℝ) =
      ![currentChenUpsilon1 N, currentChenUpsilon2 N,
        currentChenUpsilon3 N, currentChenUpsilon4 N,
        currentChenUpsilon5 N, currentChenUpsilon6 N E,
        currentChenUpsilon7 N, currentChenUpsilon8 N,
        currentChenUpsilon9 N, currentChenUpsilon10 N,
        currentChenUpsilon11 N E] i

public_declarations.name: p5MarkedElevenSource_row_filter
public_declarations.header:
theorem p5MarkedElevenSource_row_filter (N : ℕ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) (i : Fin 11) :
    (p5MarkedElevenSource N E).filter (fun t => t.1 = i) =
      (p5MarkedRowSource N E i).image (fun t => (i, t))

public_declarations.name: p5MarkedElevenSource_row_filter_card
public_declarations.header:
theorem p5MarkedElevenSource_row_filter_card (N : ℕ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) (i : Fin 11) :
    ((p5MarkedElevenSource N E).filter (fun t => t.1 = i)).card =
      (p5MarkedRowSource N E i).card

public_declarations.name: p5MarkedElevenSource_row_card_eq_upsilon
public_declarations.header:
theorem p5MarkedElevenSource_row_card_eq_upsilon
    (N : ℕ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) (i : Fin 11) :
    (((p5MarkedElevenSource N E).filter (fun t => t.1 = i)).card : ℝ) =
      ![currentChenUpsilon1 N, currentChenUpsilon2 N,
        currentChenUpsilon3 N, currentChenUpsilon4 N,
        currentChenUpsilon5 N, currentChenUpsilon6 N E,
        currentChenUpsilon7 N, currentChenUpsilon8 N,
        currentChenUpsilon9 N, currentChenUpsilon10 N,
        currentChenUpsilon11 N E] i

public_declarations.name: p5MarkedElevenSource_sum_by_row
public_declarations.header:
theorem p5MarkedElevenSource_sum_by_row (N : ℕ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop)
    (f : Fin 11 → ℝ) :
    (∑ t ∈ p5MarkedElevenSource N E, f t.1) =
      ∑ i, ((p5MarkedRowSource N E i).card : ℝ) * f i

public_declarations.name: p5MarkedElevenSource_signed_sum
public_declarations.header:
theorem p5MarkedElevenSource_signed_sum (N : ℕ) (E : ℕ × ℕ → Prop) :
    (∑ t ∈ p5MarkedElevenSource N E, p5CausalReceiverLedgerWeight t.1) =
      currentChenPairedPrimeSum N E
